limitations.reason: D30's Consequences make the Runtime timeout/ambiguous-outcome cases fixture-only; the record is the recorded-Jython fixture set, not a live run.

Neither live nor fixture-proven: no cancellation case exists on the Runtime plane at all, and D30's 'proven with recorded fixtures only' sentence is not satisfied for this case. Recorded for the owner because the phase-4 runbook cannot make it true without a new decision or a new case.
The live Runtime stages run auditMode=best_effort only; the required-mode failure branch is fixture-proven. D26's G4 acceptance asks for this case live on both Planes.
The fault proxy injects transport faults only; the D18 pre-dispatch fail-closed branch is proven by unit tests raising AuditWriteError. D26's G4 acceptance asks for this case live on both Planes.

The only live apply observation is run 35708881821 (head ffda72d), whose two defects - the percent-escaped / inside the resource type in the provider find path, and verify not deriving its endpoint from the Server Config it wrote - were fixed in 4aa9471 and are covered by the green local rehearsal tests/harness/phase4-live/rehearse_apply.py. The writes themselves were reached and observed live on that run (bundle Project imported and read back managed, Server Config created with the profile's Tools, policy provider created), so what is missing is the confirmation, not the write path.
